entry.title: How to get and use Voidheart in Hytale
entry.summary:
Voidheart is one of the rarest materials to obtain in Hytale, but finding it is worth the pain you might need to endure in the process.
Like most other items in the game, Voidheart is used as an ingredient for several recipes. However, it's not as common as Copper or Iron. This guide will lay out all the steps to follow if you're looking to obtain and use Voidheart.
Table of contents How to find Voidheart in Hytale How to use Voidheart in Hytale
How to find Voidheart in Hytale
You can only find Voidheart from Void Spawn entities that can be found anywhere on the map. When you defeat these enemies, you'll obtain Essence of the Void and Voidheart as drop rewards. These enemies only spawn at night. Hence, you'll have to fight the darkness.
Image via Hypixel
The best way to farm Voidhearts in the current build of Hytale is by defeating Void Eye enemies. You can find them in Zone 3, and the best area is the Icy Biome. You'll also find other Void enemies like skeletons and flying entities. Killing them will also reward you with Voidheart.
Screenshot by Destructoid
The major problem is the fact that Voidhearts aren't guaranteed rewards. If you defeat Void Eye enemies, it's not guaranteed that you'll get Voidheart. The item is pretty rare in my experience, so you'll need to kill a fair few (unless you're luckier than me).
How to use Voidheart in Hytale
Screenshot by Destructoid
Voidheart is a necessary item if you're planning to upgrade your Armorer's Workbench. This Workstation is where you make all armor pieces. You'll need Voidheart to upgrade the Armorer's Workbench to Tier 3, which will then allow you to make gear using Adamantite and Mithril (unavailable in Exploration).
You'll need three Voidhearts to complete the upgrade, so be prepared to endure a longer grind.

entry.title: What does Fossilized Lightning do in ARC Raiders?
entry.summary:
In ARC Raiders, you are bound to find a ton of items whose purpose might at first be obscure, unknown, or altogether mysterious. This is particularly true during the game's events, whereby its maps are fundamentally changed and given new effects, dynamic mechanics, and other crucial alterations.
The Electromagnetic Storm event transforms any given map into a rainy, stormy, dangerous environment where lightning strikes at every corner. When they do, they leave a physical mark on the world in the form of Fossilized Lightning, which players can pick up and loot.
Its purpose doesn't seem clear-cut at first, but it can be quite a rich source of another, more useful compound. Here's everything you need to know.
Fossilized Lightning item in ARC Raiders, explained
Blue Gate is a good place to find Fossilized Lightning, but the locations are random. Screenshot by Destructoid
Fossilized Lightning is an item that exclusively spawns on the Electromagnetic Storm event in ARC Raiders. It drops whenever the event's dynamic lightning strikes the ground, though it's not guaranteed. You can then loot it and bring it back to Speranza with you, where it's exclusively used as a tremendous source of Explosive Compound.
This can then be used to craft explosives, which are some of the most powerful anti-ARC tools in the entire game. With them, no ARC has armor thick enough to withstand your onslaught, especially if there are several of you throwing bombs at the same time.
While a unique and rare item, Fossilized Lightning is just a crafting source and not much more, though I'd hang on to a few of them in case the game requires them for the Expeditions or other progressions down the line. We've seen similar things happen to rather useless items before, so it's a safe bet to always keep at least some of each item in your inventory just in case.

entry.title: Fallout is dipping its toes into reality TV, and I have no clue what to think of it
entry.summary:
We live in a strange world. Video games are no longer a niche thing, nor have they been so for a very long time at this point. However, out of all the crossovers and adaptations, I never figured we'd see games dip into the world of reality TV, but Fallout is here to surprise us.
As announced by The Game Awards, Fallout Shelter is turning into a reality competition produced by Prime Video (who also produced the Fallout TV show that's actually a proper adaptation).
“Contestants live together in a vault and compete in a series of games based on attributes from Fallout,” the announcement reads, adding that these attributes have been extracted from the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. system in the games, i.e., strength, perception, endurance, charisma, intelligence, agility, and luck.
Further details have not yet been revealed, but I have to say this doesn't sound all that great. Sure, Fallout shelters are an incredible concept lore-wise and fertile ground for wonderful storytelling (just imagine a proper drama series set exclusively in a vault, something like Silo), but I reckon they're iffy as a reality competition.
In fact, this sounds like something Mr. Beast would produce on YouTube as a fun gag or sponsored gimmick, rather than Amazon Prime. It's far removed from what Fallout is, thematically, at its core, seemingly utilizing the IP and aesthetics to promote something entirely different. I'll concede that innovation and diversity are great for any given world or property, but this should just have been another reality TV without the blue vests and vaults.
But we'll know better when we see more.

entry.title: Crustle at Regionals?
Where to find Cooling Fans in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
Loot is a core part of ARC Raiders, with all sorts of items and pieces of loot necessary to progress in the game, whether it be upgrading workstations, advancing the Expedition projects, or crafting the best equipment and weapons.
Cooling Fans were required for one of the Expedition projects, and will probably be necessary to advance other events and projects down the line, making them a good item to stock up on just in case.
Here's where you can find them.
How to get Cooling Fans in ARC Raiders
The Launch Towers are a generally fantastic loot spot, but also a great source of Cooling Fans. Screenshot and remix by Destructoid
Cooling Fans can be found in Technological loot zones, which are located on just about every map in the game. However, we've had the most luck with them when raiding the Launch Towers on the Spaceport map, specifically the very top parts.
All the containers and tables are chock full of every kind of item you can think of, including Cooling Fans, which tend to spawn quite often (you'll usually get at least one per run, unless your luck is really bad that day).
On the other hand, this item can spawn within Server Racks, breachable containers that spawn on a lot of the maps, but are most easily accessed on Dam Battlegrounds. They can only be opened if you have the relevant perk unlocked in the Survival tree, which I suggest you get not only for the Cooling Fans, but for a lot of additional great loot that spawns within them as well.
Cooling Fans are, as said above, necessary for the Expeditions, so you'd do well to have a few lying in your inventory just in case they're required for any further events.

entry.title: Where to find Synthesized Fuel in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
ARC Raiders is chock full of various items that you must find by any means necessary to progress. Many of the game's quests, alongside much of its secondary progressions, are tied to unique items that can be either looted, crafted, purchased, or recycled from other pieces of loot.
Synthesized Fuel is one such item, though it's a lot easier to obtain than most other loot we've covered so far.
If you're having trouble finding it, here's what you should do.
How to get Synthesized Fuel in ARC Raiders
The Assembly is a great place to look for Exodus items like the Rocket Thrusters that'll provide two Synthesized Fuels when recycled. Screenshot and remix by Destructoid
The absolutely easiest way to obtain Synthesized Fuel is to purchase it from Celeste. She sells it from time to time for a few Assorted Seeds a pop, meaning you'll have to stock up on these through topside runs, looting them straight or recycling Herbs that you find across the game's maps.
On the other hand, Synthesized Fuel can be looted or recycled, with the latter being the more productive way. On Spaceport and Stella Montis, you can find Rocket Thrusters in Exodus loot areas, with each providing you with a couple of Synthesized Fuels per recycle. The item doesn't have that much use outside of being recycled or sold, so it's a very productive source of Synthesized Fuel, which will put your mind at ease.
It's almost guaranteed to appear in the Assembly on Stella Montis or other Exodus areas in the game, so you should check them out if Celeste purchases aren't an option.

entry.title: How to get and use Cobalt in Hytale
entry.summary:
Cobalt is one of the several metals you can find in Hytale, and it will be your source for getting some wonderful armor pieces.
The metal is necessary for crafting various gear pieces, and it's less common than Copper or Iron. Once found, you'll also need to convert it into ingots. You can then use them in recipes, depending on what you have unlocked.
Let's look at how to get Cobalt in Hytale, and what its best uses are.
Table of contents Best location for finding Cobalt in Hytale How to use Cobalt in Hytale
Best location for finding Cobalt in Hytale
To find this rare item, you'll want to head to the Whisperfront Frontiers biome. This snowy area has plenty of Shale columns located around the biome. You can mine them to get Cobalt. Typically, the amount of resources you get will be low due to their rarity. Once you find a deposit, extract as much as you can.
Screenshot by Destructoid
You can also find Cobalt in the same biome, but below the ground. The quantity you'll get is significantly lower, so it's not my favorite choice.
How to use Cobalt in Hytale
The raw Cobalt you get can't be used as a standalone item. The first thing you'll require is a Furnace. You can make a Furnace at your base, which will then allow you to smelt metals (including Cobalt). When you add fuel and Cobalt to your Furnace, you'll get Cobalt Ingots in return.
Here's a list of recipes I have found so far that require Cobalt Ingot.
Cobalt Sword
Cobalt Helm
Cobalt Cuirass
Cobalt Gauntlets
Cobalt Greaves
Cobalt Shield
You will also require a bunch of Cobalt Ingots to upgrade the Furnace, which allows you to do better smelting (and add efficiency).
If you've already found the necessary items but are unsure how to use them, here's a list of all craftable weapons and armors in the current build.

entry.title: USN-7963-1: libpng vulnerabilities
entry.summary:
It was discovered that the libpng simplified API incorrectly processed palette PNG images with partial transparency and gamma correction. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-66293)
Petr Simecek, Stanislav Fort and Pavel Kohout discovered that the libpng simplified API incorrectly processed interlaced 16-bit PNGs with 8-bit output format and non-minimal row strides. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-22695)
Cosmin Truta discovered that the libpng simplified API incorrectly handled invalid row strides. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PNG file, an attacker could use this issue to cause libpng to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-22801)

entry.title: Cloudflare Reports Surge in Streaming Piracy Takedowns, Removes 20k+ Storage Accounts
entry.summary: Cloudflare’s latest transparency report reveals a massive 3,800% surge in copyright-related takedown actions, fueled by a shift to more automated enforcement. By granting rightsholders direct API access, the company says that it was able to target live sports streaming piracy more effectively. This resulted in the termination of over 20,000 R2 storage accounts in just six months. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

entry.title: French Torrent Giant YggTorrent Faces User Revolt after Introducing Paid ‘Turbo Mode’
entry.summary: YggTorrent, the largest francophone torrent community, faces widespread pushback after it introduced a paid 'Turbo Mode' for €86 this week.
